correctness.rationale: Over clopen substitution phase Y0=Γ(Ypd), square shift lift is G=(Z/κ)^2 additive cocycle c(z)=(1,1−z0). Return cylinders of u_n=Γ^n(1) minus last char have two return words τ_(n−1),τ_n by parity-recognizable induction; increments v_n=(2^{n−1},2^{n−1}−s_(n−1)), w_n=(2^n,2^n−s_n), s_n=(2^{n+1}+(-1)^n)/3. Exact determinant ±2^{n−1}, entries gcd1, Smith diag(1,2^{n−1}); modular generated subgroup index gcd(κ,2^{n−1}) eventually q=2^{ν2κ}. Kang–Jäger finite clopen minimal-component theorem gives almost-periodic skew extension; future-cylinder/return-recurrence proof equates component stabilizer H with Hn for large n, then coset count [G:H]=q, fibre size |H|=κ²/q. Independently recalculated Smith determinant and modular indices for n2..5 and κ2..20, and inspected bundled check_components.py n2..9 κ2..17; these finite examples supplement, not replace, the infinite return-induction/continuity proof.
